## DPI

6d -> Indicates that we are changing DPI settings

01-05 -> Indicates the number of DPI profiles available, from 1 to 5 profiles; deleting/creating a new DPI profile will cause this byte to increment/decrement respectively.

**100 -> 500:**

First request:

Second request:
